item.title: Liverpool close in on £120m deal for PSG's Barcola

item.title: Why Sheffield United case could be a test for the new football regulator
item.description: Just a few short months ago, Sheffield Wednesday looked like providing the first real test of the powers of the new Independent Football Regulator. Now it appears it might well be Sheffield United.

item.title: 'Mini-Rodri' Gonzalez shown he will be loved at Newcastle

item.title: Celtic crash out of Champions League after humiliating defeat to LASK

item.title: Fenerbahce back in the Champions League after 18 years

item.description: Azerbaijan side Sabah fight back from 4-2 down on aggregate to beat Hapoel Be'er Sheva of Israel 6-4 on aggregate to secure their place in the main draw of the Champions League for the first time.

item.title: Bodo/Glimt thrash NEC to ease into Champions League main draw

item.title: 'To have a good team, we need a great Cole' - Alonso on Palmer
item.description: Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso praises Cole Palmer's "responsibility, maturity and freedom" after a goal and an assist from the playmaker seals a 3-2 victory over Fulham at Craven Cottage. In Alonso's first Premier League match in charge, the Spaniard insists his new squad can achieve "special things" this season.

item.title: Fulham deserved more in Chelsea defeat - Arbeloa
item.description: Fulham manager Alvaro Arbeloa says his side deserved "a little bit more" following their 3-2 home defeat by Chelsea but is encouraged by the "character and personality" shown in his first Premier League game in charge.
